title: Adaptive surface & interaction token mappings for brand-aware dark themes
creator: Arjun Patel
description: Goal: Define a deterministic mapping system and component override patterns so brand themes (primary, neutral, and partner variants) render consistently in dark mode across tokens, buttons, table rows, and charts. This ticket covers: 1) surface role redefinition for elevated vs. flat surfaces (surface-0..surface-4), 2) interaction states (hover/pressed/focus/disabled) mapped to tonal deltas per brand, 3) chart palette harmonization with token-driven accents, 4) table row/striping logic that meets 4.5:1 contrast for normal text and 3:1 for disabled rows, 5) lightweight component override hooks for 3rd-party data-grid and chart libs.
acceptance_criteria: A1: A token mapping document exists describing base-token -> brand-variant mappings for light/dark with delta math examples and code snippets (SASS/JS).
A2: Button & input component variants use mapped tokens and have visual regression snapshots for primary/secondary/ghost states in dark.
A3: Table row states (default, hover, selected, disabled) meet contrast targets described and are validated against sample datasets.
A4: Chart palettes are generated from tokens and produce accessible line/bar/area palettes with a provided utility function.
A5: Component override API documented (props + CSS custom properties) and two integration examples (AG Grid + Chart.js) created.
A6: Design review sign-off and a paired engineering PR linking to runtime token transforms.
A7: Migration notes for existing themes (legacy brand tokens) with automated script where feasible.
notes: Decisions so far: using a delta-based approach (Lch delta on lightness/chroma) to derive dark variants from a single brand seed color reduces divergence and maintenance cost. We will keep semantic roles (surface, elevated, emphasis, muted, interactive) and generate brand-aware variants by applying role-specific deltas. Charts will derive 6 harmonized accents from the brand seed by rotating hue and constraining chroma. Avoid per-component hardcoded colors—prefer CSS custom properties with fallbacks.
tradeoffs:
- Delta-based generation reduces QA surface but can yield edge cases with very saturated brand colors; baking a small exception map will be necessary.
- Large partner brand variations may need micro-adjustments; aim for automated suggestions first and manual overrides as second step.
- Aggressive contrast for tables can make dark-theme surfaces feel 'chalky'—we will validate with product owners and run quick user testing on sample dashboards.
implementation_plan: 1) Finalize token delta table and publish Figma token styles (figma link). 2) Add runtime generator in design tokens repo (scripts + tests). 3) Build component-level CSS custom properties and override hooks (buttons, inputs, table rows, charts). 4) Create integration examples for AG Grid and Chart.js in /examples/console-theming. 5) QA pass: visual diffs + accessibility checks + performance smoke test. 6) Rollout: behind feature flag and staged by release channels.
